SELECT: genres.display_name AS genre_name, titles.primary_title AS movie_title, titles.average_rating AS rating
FROM: titles t, titles_genres tg, genres g
ORDER_BY: 按类型分组，每个类型内按评分降序取第一条
WINDOW: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.id ORDER BY t.average_rating DESC) AS rn
notes: 需要为每个类型找到评分最高的电影。使用窗口函数 ROW_NUMBER() 按类型分区，按评分降序排列，取 rn=1 的记录。
